title: Police forced to set the record straight after wave of 'Bigfoot' sightings

Police in a small US town have been forced to set the record straight after a wave of reports claiming a mysterious Bigfoot-like creature was roaming the streets.

Officers in Damariscotta, Maine, were inundated with an ‘unusually high number of calls’ about sightings of a Sasquatch, Yeti, Bigfoot – or, as police rather diplomatically put it, ‘possibly just a very large and hairy individual’.

But after what police described as a ‘lengthy, exhaustive, and completely serious investigation’, the mystery has now been solved.

And Bigfoot believers may want to look away…

The reports were serious enough for officers to launch an investigation, with the creature reportedly spotted in several locations around town.

The Damariscotta Police Department has concluded that Bigfoot is, in fact, not real.

Instead, Officer William Smith tracked down the elusive creature sitting peacefully on the main street and discovered the mysterious creature was actually a man in a ‘very convincing’ Bigfoot costume.

There was no evidence of criminal activity and, sadly, no proof of a previously unknown species. However, Police said some officers had secretly hoped the sightings might turn out to be something bigger.

‘Frankly, there were members of our department who were secretly hoping we had finally stumbled upon something that would make national news,’ Chief Josephson said. ‘Sadly, no.’

The department thanked residents for their calls and for looking out for one another.

‘While we didn’t find Bigfoot, we did find something almost as rare: A town full of people willing to stop what they’re doing to investigate a Bigfoot sighting and keep each other safe,’ police said.
